entities.summary: Helena Maleno Garzón is a Spanish-Moroccan human rights defender, journalist, researcher, documentalist and writer. She is a specialist in the migration and trafficking in human beings, and is Doctor Honoris Causa from the University of Illes Balears. She is the Founder & CEO of Colectivo Caminando Fronteras.
